caption: The drawing features three main objects on a brown-toned background with a beige border. At the top left, there is a simple outline of a jug, with a curved handle and neck, drawn using thin blue lines. Near the jug’s lower half, there are small, stylized leaf or twig motifs. Centered in the image is a large bird, also drawn in blue. The bird is depicted in profile, facing right, with elongated tail feathers that extend horizontally and upward. It stands on a branching perch with three offshoots, and the bird’s body, wings, and tail feathers are emphasized with thick, curving lines and patterns. At the bottom of the image, there is another outlined object resembling the neck and shoulders of a large jug or bottle, drawn in blue. On this form, the words "WHITES UTICA" and the number "3" are inscribed in capital blue letters across the sloping shoulder area of the object. The overall composition is done in monochrome blue linework on a mottled brown background.
title: Stoneware Jug
